item.title: Uganda's tense elections: Internet blackout and police crackdown raise concerns
item.description: A Ugandan police officer monitors the area while guarding ballot boxes and other electoral materials for dispatch at a polling station serving as a dispatch centre during final preparations ahead of Uganda’s 2026 general elections.

item.title: Nizamiye Schools achieve 100% matric pass rate with strong maths and science results
item.description: Nizamiye Schools’ 2025 matric results show more than a perfect pass rate. Learners delivered consistently strong outcomes across key subjects, with standout distinction rates in mathematics, life sciences and advanced mathematics, and several top performers achieving between seven and ten distinctions.

item.title: How Star Colleges performed in the 2025 matric exams - beyond the 100% pass rate
item.description: A perfect pass rate was only part of Star Colleges’ 2025 matric story. Learners delivered strong results across mathematics, science and technology subjects, with high distinction rates and Bachelor-level passes positioning the majority of candidates for university study.

item.title: Standard Bank IT operator charged with embezzling R1.9m via overdraft manipulation
Understanding the new IEB volunteering requirements and why giving still matters
item.description: The IEB’s updated community service requirements aim to deepen learner engagement, but the distinction between active and passive volunteering has raised important questions. This analysis explores what still counts, what may be overlooked, and why generosity should not end when the hours are complete.

item.title: Thursday weather: Heavy rainfall and flash flood risk threatens multiple SA provinces
item.description: SAWS forecast for Thursday showing widespread rain and severe thunderstorm warnings, with the highest impact expected over Limpopo, Mpumalanga and KwaZulu-Natal.

item.title: Bafana will have a mountain to climb at the Fifa World Cup - ex Man Utd assistant coach
item.description: Bafana Bafana faces a daunting challenge at the Fifa World Cup, with former Manchester United assistant coach René Meulensteen predicting it will be difficult for them to progress beyond the group stage against strong opponents Mexico and South Korea. Picture: BackpagePix

item.title: Ex-top cop implicates Mbalula in 'messy' labour dispute
item.description: Parliament’s Ad Hoc Committee investigating serious allegations of corruption, criminal infiltration, and political interference in the criminal justice system resumed its oral hearings. The committee kicked off the new year’s proceedings with former Acting National Police Commissioner Lieutenant General Khomotso Phahlane as a witness.

item.description: It's finally Senuran Muthusamy's time to shine.
